svg.title: Water storage anomaly, July 2026
svg.text: Equivalent water height of the GRACE-FO July 2026 field relative to the 2004–2009 mean (72 months); degree 60, destriped, 300 km Gaussian.
COST-G RL02.1 monthly fields (ICGEM); C₂₀ and C₃₀ from satellite laser ranging (TN-14), degree 1 from TN-13. Glacial isostatic adjustment not removed.
Equal Earth projection. Coastlines: Natural Earth (public domain). Data: COST-G (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5880/COST-G.ICGEM_02_L2); NASA GRACE technical notes 13 and 14.
